source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description:
War Child

You grew up in a region ravaged by warfare, where danger lies around every dawn. The times you spent hiding away from soldiers, fighting back against the assaults, or simply helping those who did so unsuccessfully. You have left that world behind now, whether the war itself ended or if you simply left never to look back. But the time spent in war will never let you return to the one you once were.

Skill Proficiencies: Survival, Stealth

Tool Proficiencies: Trappers Kit

Equipment: A keepsake from your old home, a set of commoners clothes and physical memento of the people, or person that destroyed your family and home.

Equipment Pack: Explorer’s Pack or Field Medic Pack (Choose one).

Feature: Survivors Instincts

Growing up in a war zone sharpened your awareness of danger to a razor's edge. In an active battle zone, you cannot be surprised while conscious. When you enter a location for the first time you automatically identify all exits, major cover positions, and obvious threats without making a check.

Survivor

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Wisdom based Skill Feat)
